name: Marketing
description: Creates awareness, generates demand, and builds strong brand relationships with target audiences

roles.name: Marketing Manager
roles.description: Develops and executes comprehensive marketing strategies to drive brand awareness and demand generation
responsibilities: Develop marketing strategies and campaign plans
Create compelling marketing messages and value propositions
Manage marketing budgets and resource allocation

roles.name: Digital Marketing Specialist
roles.description: Executes digital marketing campaigns across various online channels and platforms
responsibilities: Manage social media campaigns and content strategy
Optimize digital advertising campaigns and performance
Implement email marketing and automation strategies
Analyze digital marketing metrics and optimize performance

roles.name: Content Marketing Specialist
roles.description: Creates engaging content that attracts, educates, and converts target audiences
responsibilities: Develop content strategies and editorial calendars
Create compelling blog posts, whitepapers, and marketing materials
Optimize content for SEO and audience engagement
Measure content performance and engagement metrics

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive marketing strategy and campaign plan based on target audience and business objectives.
Create compelling content and messaging that aligns with the marketing strategy.
Develop digital marketing tactics and channel strategies to execute the campaign.
Finalize the integrated marketing campaign with performance metrics and success criteria.
